_note: Name-facts for Mongolia (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: The coldest national capital in the world, by average temperature.
It began as a moving monastery town, and settled here only in 1778.
it: La capitale nazionale più fredda del mondo, per temperatura media.
Nacque come città-monastero itinerante, e si stabilì qui solo nel 1778.
de: Die kälteste Hauptstadt der Welt, gemessen an der Durchschnittstemperatur.
Sie begann als wandernde Klosterstadt und ließ sich erst 1778 hier nieder.
